what: L1 capture (EVAL_CAPTURE_L1=1, the eval_test_runner default) disables and clears the program cache around every graded test, so any loose case that captures a trace fails with TT_FATAL Cannot load new binaries during trace capture (stock ttnn.add reproduces it). A refusal-only loose case raises L1ProfilingError peak_total=0 because a correctly refused call allocates nothing. A correct op reports 9/11.
suggest: Skip L1 capture, or keep the program cache on, for loose cases that call begin_trace_capture or only exercise refusals (e.g. an extras flag the harness honours)

what: The verifier instructions require every perf refinement to target the attention-flagged LOOSE_CASE, but perf_rules.txt forbids measuring or targeting cells of 32 tiles or fewer and overrides everything. The flagged g6 perf case is 7 tiles, so the two instructions contradict and no perf refinement can be filed.
suggest: State in the verifier perf-refinement section (and in the attention-note convention) that a flagged case at or under the perf_rules size floor yields no perf refinement, or exempt flagged cases from the floor

what: Phase 0 SUPPORTED and TARGET list alignment=h_non_aligned only, while the Rules MUST says the op handles every B, K, d1, d2, W and must not refuse another shape on the host. Following the prompt literally violates the MUST, and widening SUPPORTED leaves it above TARGET with no golden cell for the new values.
suggest: List all three alignment tags in TARGET and Phase 0 SUPPORTED for ROW_MAJOR ops whose kernel does not branch on alignment, with one INPUTS shape per tag
